label: epa-vs-statbotics
rationale: SC-2 (quick task 260904-4aa): tolerance bands for scripts/epaVsStatbotics.ts --check, built from the offseason-inclusive, full-range (2022-2026) run's min-matches(>=12) arm — matching packages/harness/epaStatboticsCompare.ts's compareSeason output and production's own publish:seasons stream composition (includeOffseason: true). The min-matches arm (not the all-teams arm) is the gated one: low-match teams are noisy on both sides and would otherwise dominate meanAbsoluteDifference (see docs/models/epa-vs-statbotics.md). Bands are centred on the measured value: ordinaryLeastSquaresSlope/pearson at +/-0.05, meanAbsoluteDifference at +/-1.0 points, and both standard deviations at +/-max(1.5, 10% of the measured value) so a season with a much larger point scale (2026: ourSD ~51) is not gated by an absolute band sized for a smaller-scale season (2022: ourSD ~10). This corpus/EPA computation is deterministic (no randomness in the aggregate statistics), so re-running scripts/epaVsStatbotics.ts unchanged reproduces these figures exactly -- the bands exist to catch a REAL regression in EPA's attribution arithmetic or component extraction, not day-to-day measurement noise. The 2026 season is still in progress as of this baseline's creation date; its own row will need re-measuring (and likely widening or replacing) as more of that season is played and both our own EPA state and Statbotics' team-year figures shift with it -- this is a known, named limitation of gating a live season, not an oversight. RE-MEASURED 2026-09-04 (quick task 260904-5px, D-05): the bands above were measured 2026-09-04 under the retired epa@2.0.0+baseline. That version's fouls-exclusion change (D-01, this same quick task) was FIRST verified as an arithmetic identity against those untouched 2.0.0 bands -- scripts/epaVsStatbotics.ts --check passed with this file byte-identical to the 2.0.0-measured committed record (see the prior commit) -- proving the fouls exclusion moving from the compare script into epa.teamMetrics() double-subtracts nothing. Re-measurement (this commit) was required only because adopting Statbotics' elimination discount (D-05: EPA_ELIM_WEIGHT applied to the outer EWMA blend of an elimination-match observation, and the per-team match counter no longer advancing on an elimination match) genuinely changes how ratings evolve -- unlike the fouls change, this one legitimately moves the measured statistics, so the bands below are recentred on freshly measured epa@5.0.0+baseline values using the SAME half-width formula the 2.0.0 bands used; no half-width needed to grow. The 5.0.0 measurement also reflects quick task 260904-6a1's intervening adjust-pinning/adjust-zeroed-alliance model change (epa@3.0.0+baseline -> 4.0.0+baseline), which landed between the fouls change and this elimination change and is folded into these figures alongside D-05 -- the movement from the 2.0.0 baseline to this one is NOT attributable to the elimination discount alone. See docs/models/epa-vs-statbotics.md's before/after table for the attribution breakdown and the accuracy/Brier movement under the win-probability model.
